item.title: On Religion: A journalist who was a Catholic and a Catholic journalist
item.description: This massive investigation into sexual abuse by Catholic clergy won the 2003 Pulitzer Prize for Public Service, forcing major newsrooms to cover a scandal that had festered for decades. The shockwaves continued in Boston, and more than a decade later, The Globe launched a website—Crux (Latin for "cross")—to cover Catholic news.
